paragraphs: In the time of Rabbi [Yehudah HaNasi], in Tosefta Oholot ch. 18: An incident involving Rabbi [Yehudah HaNasi], Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yose, and Rabbi Elazar HaKappar, who spent Shabbat in the shop of Pazi in Lod. Hyman reports this reading in the Zuckermandel Tosefta, Kaftor va-Ferach ch. 11, and the Rash there. His own text reads “in the shop of a Cuthean (Samaritan).” The consulted Tosefta has “in the shop of an idolater.”

notes.text: Pazi’s shop and a Samaritan’s shop are different textual readings. The Zuckermandel, Kaftor vaFerach and commentator attributions are Hyman’s reports.
